sources.title: Agent Skills Overview - Agent Skills
sources.snippet: Agent Skills are a lightweight, open format for extending AI agent capabilities with specialized knowledge and workflows. At its core, a skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file. This file includes metadata (name and description, at minimum) and instructions that tell an agent how to perform a specific task. Skills can also bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources.

sources.title: Agent Skills — The skill registry for AI agents
sources.snippet: A curated, open registry of composable skills for AI agents. Install with one command, ship in minutes. Built for developers, by developers.

sources.title: Agentic AI Governance as Infrastructure — Jerson Boyd Milan
sources.snippet: Agentic AI Governance as Infrastructure Why architecture, not policy, will determine the future of autonomous intelligence. As agent networks execute thousands of recursive sub-tasks per second, the window for human intervention collapses to zero. The AGIF — a 10-layer stack — embeds governance not as policy, but as runtime constraint.
